caption: The drawing depicts a single wooden object resembling a cylindrical vessel or cup that widens slightly towards the top and is supported by a round, thick base. The vessel is rendered in shades of brown with visible wood grain patterns, including swirls and lines in light yellow-brown, deep brown, and some reddish-brown hues that suggest natural wood texture. The object is made of segmented staves fitted together vertically, with eveident separations and cracks along the seams. The base is also composed of several wood segments fitted in a circular arrangement. The background is a plain, light beige color with no additional elements or decorations, and the signature of the artist appears in the lower left quadrant.
title: Mortar
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
